notes.title: Rocksteady confirms it is working on a Suicide Squad game
notes.content:
Rocksteady has confirmed an earlier Eurogamer report it is working on a Suicide Squad game.

In a tweet showing an image of a decrepit-looking Superman with a target on his head, the Batman Arkham developer revealed the Suicide Squad game will be announced on 22nd August, during the DC Fandome event.

In June, Eurogamer's Tom Phillips rubber-stamped a domain name-fuelled rumour that Rocksteady was working on a game centred on DC's Suicide Squad.

notes.title: Valve Index Controller support is live!
notes.content:
Hi Folks,

With Batman Day quickly approaching we hope you’re getting ready to celebrate the day of everyone’s favourite caped crusader. As of this year, the Dark Knight has been protecting Gotham from its worst inhabitants for 80 years! 

His legendary repertoire of gadgets and methods to fight crime have grown so much since his debut in 1939. For those us who are joining him today in bringing the criminals of Gotham to justice, we’re making sure that you too have access to all the latest and greatest tools and gadgetry. 

From today, Batman: Arkham VR offers full support for the Valve Index Controllers so you too can use the latest VR tech to tackle crime in Gotham.

[u]New Features[/u]
[list]
    [*]Added Support for the Valve Index Controllers.
    [*]Implemented OpenVR Mesh.
[/list]
If you encounter any issues, don’t hesitate to let us know. 

- Rocksteady Team
